name: Apiole
summary: Apiole is a phenylpropene, also known as apiol, parsley apiol, or parsley camphor. Its chemical name is 1-allyl-2,5-dimethoxy-3,4-methylenedioxybenzene. It is found in the essential oils of celery leaf and all parts of parsley. Heinrich Christoph Link, an apothecary in Leipzig, discovered the substance in 1715 as greenish crystals reduced by steam from oil of parsley.

uses.text: In medicine it has been used, as essential oil or in purified form, for the treatment of menstrual disorders and as an abortifacient. Plants containing apiole were used by women in the Middle Ages to terminate pregnancies.

pharmacology.en: It is not a psychoactive drug. It irritates the lining of the womb and stimulates contractions, which is the basis of its historical use, and it is toxic to the liver and kidneys.
pharmacology.zh: 它不是精神作用藥物。它會刺激子宮內膜並促進收縮，這是它歷史用途的基礎，同時它對肝臟與腎臟有毒性。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它不是精神作用药物。它会刺激子宫内膜并促进收缩，这是它历史用途的基础，同时它对肝脏与肾脏有毒性。

sideEffects.en: Concentrated parsley oil and apiole have caused severe poisoning: vomiting, stomach pain, liver and kidney damage, bleeding, convulsions and death. Attempts to end pregnancy with it have killed people.
sideEffects.zh: 濃縮巴西利油與洋香菜腦曾造成嚴重中毒：嘔吐、腹痛、肝腎損傷、出血、抽搐與死亡。以它嘗試終止懷孕已造成人命損失。
sideEffects.zhHans: 浓缩巴西利油与洋香菜脑曾造成严重中毒：呕吐、腹痛、肝肾损伤、出血、抽搐与死亡。以它尝试终止怀孕已造成人命损失。

fact.en: Apiole is the main scented compound in parsley seed oil, which is why it is also called parsley camphor. Its methylenedioxy ring is the same chemical feature found in safrole and in MDMA.
fact.zh: 洋香菜腦是巴西利種子油中主要的芳香化合物，因此也被稱為巴西利樟腦。它的亞甲二氧基環與黃樟素和 MDMA 中的化學特徵相同。
fact.zhHans: 洋香菜脑是巴西利种子油中主要的芳香化合物，因此也被称为巴西利樟脑。它的亚甲二氧基环与黄樟素和 MDMA 中的化学特征相同。
